senses.gloss:
अर्मः, -र्मम्
 [ऋ-मन् Uṇ. 1. 137]
—1 A disease of the eye.
—2 A country to which one should go (गन्तव्यदेशः or चिरन्तनग्रामनिवासः).
—3 A cemetery.
—4 (pl.) Ruins, rubbish; Vāj. 30. 11.

अर्मः, -र्मम्
 [ऋ-मन् Uṇ. 1. 137]
—1 A disease of the eye.
—2 A country to which one should go (गन्तव्यदेशः or चिरन्तनग्रामनिवासः).
—3 A cemetery.
—4 (pl.) Ruins, rubbish; Vāj. 30. 11.
अर्मणम् A measure of one droṇa.
अर्मन् n. [ऋ-मनिन्] A disease of the eye (said to be of 5 kinds).
